notes.title: Ravenlok: Legendary Edition Launching April 11th
notes.content:
We're excited to share that Ravenlok: Legendary Edition is coming to Steam on [b]Friday April 11th[/b]!

Get a taste for this action-packed fantasy adventure by playing the [b]Free Demo[/b] available right on the game page and don't forget to [b]add to your Wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072290/Ravenlok_Legendary_Edition

[h3]Ravenlok: Legendary Edition - What's New?[/h3]

- Updated Combat Mechanics
- Improved Enemies and Bosses
- Remastered 3D models for some Enemies
- New Enemies
- Four new Levels: Sugar Swamp, The Labyrinth, Sealed Temple and Souls Catacomb
- Quality of Life fixes
- Includes all previous updates and patches like the 360 Panoramic Camera and Languages updates
